source.content: @isTest private class AssuranceMissingDeterministicSurfacesTest { @isTest static void rows() { Answers answers = new Answers(); System.assertNotEquals(null, answers); System.assertNotEquals(null, answers.clone()); Cache.Visibility visibility = Cache.Visibility.ALL; System.assertEquals(Cache.Visibility.ALL, visibility); Messaging.SingleEmailMessage email = new Messaging.SingleEmailMessage(); email.setToAddresses(new List<String>{'assurance@example.test'}); List<Messaging.Email> emails = new List<Messaging.Email>{email}; List<Messaging.SendEmailResult> results = Messaging.sendEmail(emails, false); Messaging.SendEmailResult result = results[0]; Messaging.SendEmailError error = result.getErrors().isEmpty() ? null : result.getErrors()[0]; System.assertNotEquals(null, result); System.assert(error == null || error.getMessage() != null); Metadata.DeployCallbackContext callbackContext = new Metadata.DeployCallbackContext(); Metadata.DeployDetails details = new Metadata.DeployDetails(); Metadata.DeployMessage message = new Metadata.DeployMessage(); Metadata.Operations operations = new Metadata.Operations(); System.assertNotEquals(null, callbackContext); System.assertNotEquals(null, details); System.assertNotEquals(null, message); System.assertNotEquals(null, operations); Messaging.SingleEmailMessage systemMessaging = new Messaging.SingleEmailMessage(); System.assertNotEquals(null, systemMessaging); Account account = new Account(Name = 'assurance search'); insert account; Test.setFixedSearchResults(new List<Id>{account.Id}); List<List<SObject>> searchRows = Search.query('FIND {assurance*} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name)'); System.assertEquals(1, searchRows.size()); } }
